escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a handoff inherited from a base branch as readiness for a different delivery merely because the artifact file exists and is internally valid.

literal_case.observed: The current package is rebuilt for the current delivery target and does not treat inherited artifacts as current readiness.

sibling_cases.evidence: Foreign base artifact remains historical only.
Foreign changed artifact cannot activate handoff reuse.

evidence: Current delivery package must bind repository, issue, PR, branch, base and material SHA.
Target binding and terminal handoff validation run before independent audit.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Translate a failed required invoice resource request into a valid empty collection or zero financial summary so the page appears healthy.

literal_case.observed: A purchases failure routes to the explicit error page and cannot render the empty purchase state.

sibling_cases.evidence: Summary failure routes to explicit error before summary values render.
Accounts, categories, instruments and recurrences failures route to explicit error before dependent actions render.

evidence: Required invoice/card resources are checked for ok=false before any semantic fallback or financial composition.
Focused regression source covers literal purchases failure and sibling summary/accounts/categories/instruments/recurrences failures.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Render a numeric instrument credit limit outside the money primitive without carrying the invoice currency, while other money values remain correctly labeled.

literal_case.observed: Instrument limit text now includes the selected invoice ISO currency before the localized numeric value.

sibling_cases.evidence: Every instrument limit in the same invoice uses the same explicit invoice currency.
Missing currency renders an unavailable-currency label instead of an unlabeled numeric amount.

evidence: Instrument label formatting requires currency before it may render a numeric limit.
Focused regression requires limite USD 1.000,00 and rejects raw limite 1.000,00 and limite 500,00 forms.
